documents.content:
Alpha — Project Charter
DEMO — SYNTHETIC DATA. This document is fictional and intended exclusively for prototype search, citations and workflow demonstrations.
1. Business context
Alpha addresses the following operational need: Permission-aware enterprise search, cited answers, document drafting, ontology-aware task coordination and auditable approvals.
Project accountability: manager Riya Sen; sponsoring function Operations Director; owning department Engineering. Work begins 2026-09-07 with target delivery 2026-12-18.
2. Scope and deliverables
Delivery scope: Permission-aware enterprise search, cited answers, document drafting, ontology-aware task coordination and auditable approvals.
Explicit exclusions: purchase of production infrastructure, use of actual customer credentials, or claims of production regulatory approval in this demonstration.
D1. Document search with verified source passages
D2. Organisation and project graph with role-aware access
D3. Draft creation, export and versioned approvals
D4. Regression tests and online demo
3. Delivery milestones
4. Project governance
Every task is linked to a project and assigned owner. Changes to approved documents require a new version and an approval record. The project manager is Riya Sen.
Approval reference: APR-001 linked to ALP-102. Source records must retain immutable IDs across search and Work actions.
5. Delivery risk and control
Citation highlighting can drift if source paragraphs change; preserve versioned source offsets and a fallback paragraph locator.
The project manager reviews the risk register weekly and escalates changes that affect delivery dates or scope.
6. Acceptance criteria
All listed deliverables must have reviewable evidence, owner and completion state. No task or approval status is inferred from document text alone; the application database is authoritative.

documents.title: Alpha — Operating Procedure
documents.content:
Alpha — Operating Procedure
DEMO — SYNTHETIC DATA. This document is fictional and intended exclusively for prototype search, citations and workflow demonstrations.
1. Purpose and applicability
This operating procedure applies to Alpha and its linked Engineering work records.
Operational control: A reviewer must inspect the exact submitted revision before approving a draft; approval does not modify the original document.
2. Operating steps
Step 1. Confirm identity, the relevant project membership and current permissions.
Step 2. Open the relevant task, document or incident using its unique ID.
Step 3. Review linked evidence and confirm the document version.
Step 4. Record the proposed change and provide a clear reason.
Step 5. Route any controlled decision to an authorised reviewer.
Step 6. After a valid decision, update the target object and preserve its audit history.
Step 7. Verify the new state through search and a refreshed application session.
3. Exception handling
Known scenario: INC-001 — Document export loses section numbering.
If the action is blocked, leave the record in its actual state, record the reason and notify Riya Sen or the authorised owner. Never fabricate completion.
4. Records and citations
Related charter: ALP-DOC-CHARTER-001. Related status: ALP-DOC-STATUS-001. Related decision: ALP-DOC-DECISIONS-001.
A citation refers to the immutable source document ID, version and section heading. PDF exports should also carry the corresponding page locator after indexing.
5. Access and retention
A user may discover only metadata and text passages their permissions allow. Source documents are versioned, and older approved versions remain available to authorised reviewers.
